name: deployment_matches_reviewed_commit
description: Checks whether a deployment used the same commit that was approved in review.

claim.text: The deployed commit matches the reviewed and approved commit.

review.commit_sha.probe: log reviewed commit_sha from the review system
review.commit_sha.why: Without the reviewed commit, deployment evidence cannot be compared to the approved artifact.

review.decision.why: Without the review decision, a review record does not show approval.

review.approved_at.why: Without the approval timestamp, the compiler cannot check review-before-deploy ordering.

deployment.commit_sha.probe: log deployed commit_sha from the deployment job
deployment.commit_sha.why: Without the deployed commit, the compiler cannot compare deployment to review.

deployment.deployed_at.why: Without deployment time, the compiler cannot check chronology.
